description: This file is a PHP source code for a web interface page that manages DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) settings, including IPv4 and IPv6 host configurations, with embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and interaction.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of its segments, handling '::' abbreviation.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if input fields with a specific prefix are blank, considering IPv6 prefix requirements.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates input field values with a separator to form an IP address string.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on current form state.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address input is required based on current form state.

methods.name: populate_IPv6
methods.description: Populates IPv6 address input fields based on the IPv6 prefix and current address.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends the DMZ configuration data via AJAX to the server for saving.
